title: [GMCP 203.005.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Production-grade stdio transport
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-005-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: GMCP serves and consumes MCP over stdio with byte-accurate framing, bounded lines/messages, strict stdout protocol purity, stderr diagnostics, environment and working-directory control, graceful cancellation and shutdown, child-tree cleanup, backpressure, timeout handling, and Windows/Unix parity. Crash, hang, malformed output, descriptor leak, and hostile child fixtures all recover without stranding resources. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
